projection: Prefer the back_project(row, col, step=NN) MCP tool; it uses the 1024x1024 high-resolution world map by default. Pass resolution='low' only when row/col came from the 256x256 calibration-frame image.
note: The agentview_depth.npz observation is aligned with agentview.png. agentview_policy.png uses the Pi0 orientation and must not supply pixels for back-projection.
